# POLCERO

> POLCERO builds autonomous robots for industry and agriculture. Not a single robot — an ecosystem of three layers that only make sense together: an AI platform that plans and supervises tasks, a transport platform (including a 500 kg-payload transport drone), and modular humanoid robots with swappable end-effectors. The client assigns a goal, not a motion. Designed, built and serviced in Poland; data and compliance stay in the EU.

## Core idea
- Layer 1 — AI platform (POLCERO OS): takes the task, plans it, supervises the run, documents the result. Can run locally, on-device.
- Layer 2 — Transport: a 500 kg-payload transport drone delivers robots and materials where access is costly or impossible (prototype exists).
- Layer 3 — Modular humanoid robot: shared core, swappable end-effectors; reads the situation and picks its own tool.

## Business model
- Sale of robots built around a specific client process (turnkey, from PLN 2M upward).
- Seasonal rental (agriculture).
- Settlement for work done — the client pays for the result; robot and operators stay with POLCERO.

## Where it works
- Industry: humanoid on a mobile platform in halls designed for people.
- Agriculture: selective manipulation in soft crops, tunnels and greenhouses.
- Logistics: transport where the road ends.

## Business branches
- ICB Robots (LIVE) — industrial cobots, autonomous forklifts and AMRs, to order.
- AI Systems (TO ORDER) — the AI brain for any robot: perception, planning, autonomy, fleet management.
- Robots (TO ORDER) — the POLCERO modular platform + a catalog of specialized robots.
- Farma AI (TO ORDER) — autonomous field-robot fleet with the AI-farmer brain; RaaS model.
- Photonic Processors (R&D) — photonic computing to accelerate AI inference at lower power.
